summary: Specifies how PCEP carries a Binding Segment Identifier (BSID), as described in RFC 8402. A BSID can be tied to an RSVP-TE signaled LSP or SR path so upstream nodes can steer traffic into it, helping scalability and service independence.

eli5.summary: A BSID is a nickname for a long route, so you can say just the nickname. This explains how the route planner passes that nickname around.
